file.label.title: Title
settings.title: Jira Weaver
settings.authModeDesc: Bearer token for Jira Server / Data Center. Basic auth (email + API token) for Jira Cloud.
settings.emailDesc: Email address used with Basic auth (Jira Cloud only).
settings.domainDesc: Base URL of your Jira instance, e.g. https://mycompany.atlassian.net.
settings.tokenDesc: Token used to authenticate API requests. Stored locally; never shared.
settings.profilesDesc: Each enabled profile is synced in sequence. Add multiple profiles to sync different JQL queries into different folders.
settings.profileAtLeastOne: At least one profile is required.
settings.nullBehaviorDesc: How to handle Jira fields whose value is null/empty. "omit" leaves the key out; "explicit" writes null.
settings.languageDesc: Plugin UI, notices, and generated file content language. "Auto" follows your Obsidian app language.
settings.triggerDesc: How sync runs are started. "Manual" uses the command palette only. "On startup" syncs once when Obsidian opens. "Interval" syncs periodically.
settings.intervalDesc: Used only when trigger is "Interval". Minimum 1, maximum 1440.
settings.memoBehaviorDesc: How to sync a file whose <!-- jira-weaver:end --> marker has been removed (memo protection unavailable).
settings.memoBehaviorAppend: Append new block to file end
mapping.reloadDesc: Fetch the current Jira field list from /rest/api/2/field. Required to see custom fields.
mapping.availableEmpty: No fields cached yet — click "Reload fields" after entering connection details.
mapping.activeEmpty: No active mappings. Enable fields on the left.
mapping.addCustomFieldIdDesc: e.g. customfield_10016 — exactly as it appears in the Jira REST API.
mapping.descriptionLocked: description is always rendered into the body section, never Frontmatter.
modal.title: Field Settings: {{id}} ({{name}})
modal.obsidianKeyDesc: YAML key written into the file's Frontmatter (lowercase, underscores).
modal.valueTypeDesc: How the raw Jira value is normalized.
modal.wikiLinkDesc: Wrap the resolved value as an Obsidian wiki link. Useful for ontology/Graph View.
modal.jsonPathDesc: Leave empty for auto-extraction. Supports dot, [index] and [*] wildcard, e.g. fields.sprint[0].name.
modal.previewMissing: (no preview — connect Jira and reload fields to see live data)
notice.settingsIncomplete: Jira Weaver: please complete connection settings before syncing.
notice.syncDone: Jira Weaver sync complete — created {{created}}, updated {{updated}}, skipped {{skipped}}, errors {{errors}}.
notice.syncDoneWithMarkerWarnings: Jira Weaver sync complete — created {{created}}, updated {{updated}}, skipped {{skipped}}, errors {{errors}}. ⚠ {{markers}} file(s) had no marker.
notice.syncDoneEmpty: Jira Weaver: no issues matched your JQL.
notice.offlineSkip: Jira Weaver: offline — sync skipped, will retry on next interval.
error.network: Jira Weaver: network error — check connection and domain URL.
error.auth: Jira Weaver: authentication failed — verify your Personal Access Token.
error.parse: Jira Weaver: could not parse Jira response.
